BOOK ONE · LESSON 086

What have you done?

你已经做了什么？

A picture-based lesson on the present perfect tense (have/has + past participle). Fifteen illustrations show completed actions: aired, cleaned, opened, sharpened, turned on, listened to, boiled, answered, emptied, asked, typed, washed, walked, painted, dusted. Written exercises A (put 'has' in present-perfect sentences) and B (rewrite imperatives as 'I've already done it / I did it...' pairs) are transcribed from the textbook. Workbook practice covers 'Have you ever been to...' dialogues, 'I've already done it / I did it an hour ago' sentence completion, and open-ended situation questions. Grammar exercises practise answering 'and' questions with present-perfect/past-simple pairs and giving correct replies to observations.

Listen and answer the questions

Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

Fifteen pictures show completed actions. Listen to the recording and answer: What have you done? 十五幅图片展示了已完成的动作。听录音并回答：你已经做了什么？

Listen to the recording and identify which action has been completed in each picture.

Written exercises A — Put 'has' in the present-perfect sentences

Look at these two sentences. 注意以下两个例句。

She has already aired the room.
She aired it this morning.

In which of these sentences can we put has? 在下面的句子中有一般过去时和现在完成时两种不同的时态。选出现完成时的句子，并填上 has。

Add 'has' to each present-perfect sentence (not the past-simple sentence).

Answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 86 key (img/key-085-090.jpg).

Written exercises B — Rewrite the imperatives

Rewrite these sentences. 模仿例句改写以下祈使句。

Example:
Air the room! (this morning)
→ I've already aired the room. / I aired the room this morning.

Rewrite each imperative as a present-perfect sentence ('I've already...') and a past-simple sentence with the given time expression.
